title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.20321v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. translated_title: 模拟器误设带来的不合理自信：SPEED+仿真到真实基准上的方向性鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 面向轨道的视觉导航系统几乎必须完全依靠合成图像进行训练，因为在轨飞行的特定航天器几乎不存在真实带标注的图像。像SPEED+这样的基准正是为此类情形而构建的：训练集来自模拟器，测试集则是卫星模型在两种光照条件下的真实图像。该模拟器近似了光线从聚酯薄膜和铝表面反射的方式，但和所有科学模拟器一样，它存在设定误差。其误差属于辐射度层面，因为它缺失了真实图像中常见的镜面高光、硬阴影和传感器饱和现象。我们用一个刻意保持简单的单目姿态估计器来探究由此产生的合成到真实差距——这是此类系统的核心风险。在一项关于骨干网络适配与光度增强的2×2研究中，模型在合成图像上训练，并在两个真实硬件在环域上进行测试，我们发现了三点结论。（1）模型并不知道它正在失效……
tldr: 该论文通过一个刻意简化的单目姿态估计器，在SPEED+仿真到真实基准上系统探究模拟器辐射度误设造成的合成到真实差距，发现模型在失效时仍表现出不合理的过度自信。
en_tdlr: Using a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator on the SPEED+ sim-to-real benchmark, this paper probes the synthetic-to-real gap caused by radiometric simulator misspecification and finds that the model exhibits unreasonable confidence even when it fails.
